correctness.rationale: For all d>=3, any distinct a,b,c, nonzero real J and positive kappa,gamma_b,gamma_c, the stationary Cesaro-state argument is sound: trace loss forces P_aR=0, the Hilbert-Schmidt purity identity forces commutation with both local dephasers, and the nonzero J^h h! shortest-walk amplitude excludes dephaser site mass from the H-invariant support. Hence only the common spectral dark space survives. In each Walsh eigenspace k=1,...,d-1, coordinate swaps yield evaluation rank 3 without an antipodal pair and 2 with any antipodal pair, while k=0,d rank is 1. Thus bright dimension is 3d-1 or 2d, and absorption is exactly 1-tr(P_D rho0) for arbitrary density matrices. I separately constructed Walsh evaluation matrices (not repository Gram determinants) for every anchored unordered three-monitor configuration in d=3,4,5,6 and checked all ranks and summed dimensions. This finite corroboration is not the proof for unbounded d.
